title: Nagara deploy log line
description: One JSON object per line per deploy, appended by the ship core to r2://<bucket>/ops/deploys/<product>.jsonl. It is also the promotion record (sha -> digest -> environments) and the input of common/bin/dora.sh. Unknown fields are allowed so the ship core can add context (crate-ship writes `ref`).

env.description: an entry of SHIP_ENVS, e.g. staging or production

digest.description: image digest deployed; production must reuse the staging digest

prev_sha.description: sha that was live before; empty on a first deploy. Lead time counts prev_sha..sha

tag.description: the owner-signed tag a production deploy used; the image tag otherwise

who.description: git user.email@host of the owner's machine

rollback_of.description: set when result is rolled_back: the sha (or container version) traffic went back to

hotfix.description: true when this deploy fixes a failure in a recent one (counts toward change failure rate and rework rate)

kit_version.description: the .nagara-cicd version of the product at that sha
